title: Benchmarking the Future of Work: Mapping AI Progress to Occupational Exposure

contributions.purpose: 提出用 AI benchmark 进展衡量职业 AI 暴露度的新指标
contributions.mechanism: 以 O*NET 为桥,通过 6 步 AI 标注把 benchmark(MMLU/GSM8K/ImageNet 等)映射到 52 项 O*NET 能力与任务,按任务重要度和频率加权聚合为 Benchmark-based AI Occupational Exposure(BAIOE)指数
contributions.evaluation: 方法论构建:任务级 0-10 评分归一后凸组合 X_τ=λT̃+ (1-λ)H̃,再按 O*NET 权重聚合到职业
contributions.domain: 劳动经济学 / AI 对未来工作的影响
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a new measure of an occupation's exposure to AI that we call the Benchmark-based AI Occupational Exposure (BAIOE), which systematically links AI benchmark progress ... to the occupational tasks that define human labor.

contributions.mechanism: 对全体职业计算 BAIOE 并列出最暴露/最不暴露前 20
contributions.evaluation: 最不暴露为体力/服务类(洗碗工、清洁工);最暴露反直觉地为飞行员、医生、消防员,作者自认'reflects some methodological issues'(暴露指数对全部任务聚合,边缘任务盖过核心能力)
contributions.source_quote: the list of most exposed occupations, which includes airline pilots, physicians, and firefighters, appears less intuitive. This unexpected outcome likely reflects some methodological issues.

contributions.purpose: 验证按任务相关度筛选可改善排名
contributions.mechanism: 剔除对职业核心功能不相关的任务后重排
contributions.evaluation: 分野更清晰:低暴露仍集中于体力/服务/清洁,高暴露稳定聚在科学/技术/专业领域(物理学家、工程师、医生)
contributions.source_quote: By narrowing the focus to central tasks, this approach enhances the robustness of the framework, producing rankings that more closely align with intuitive expectations.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our methodological approach of mapping AI benchmark performance into occupational exposure builds on two recent papers. First, Felten et al. (2021) map the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) AI Progress Measurement project to O*NET tasks ... Second, Eloundou et al. (2024) map large language model capabilities to O*NET tasks using a structured labeling approach.
